about_the_game:
A Spore-t of the Moment and A Good Roll of the Shrooms

To restore the Mushroom Empire to its former glory, you must roll the dice each turn to gather action points and use them wisely. Whether it's sending your shroomies into action, crafting epic weapons, or more, every decision counts. Strategize your moves and lead your warriors to a spore-tacular victory!

Commander, Prepare Your Strategy for Battle!

You’ll be joined by three mighty mushroom companions, each with unique abilities. Make the most of their special skills and reclaim the battlefield! To strengthen your army, you must:

  • Gather resources

  • Forge powerful weapons

  • Collect cards

As you build your strength, you’ll unlock more powerful weapons, explore mysterious realms, and face even stranger creatures. The challenges will grow more intense, as you declare war on increasingly powerful enemies!

May the Spores Be With You

Finally, it’s time to lead your Mushroom Army deep into the heart of the Empire! The objectives of the Mushroom Empire are simple:

  • Defeat the monsters

  • Open the portals 

  • Conquer new battle zones

But hold onto your spores—this journey won’t be easy. Along with the enemies you’ll face, there’s a fearsome boss waiting for you at the end of each island... Can you outlast the challenge and claim victory?

short_description: A lighthearted, turn-based strategy game where you command an army of shroomies and conquer new lands. Roll the dice and plan your moves wisely—craft gear, hunt for resources, and draw powerful cards. With the right strategy and a bit of luck, your Mushroom Empire will rise to greatness!
